title: Canonical finite map is a closed immersion
statement: For every morphism f, point y and n, formalFunctionsFiniteι f y n is a closed immersion.

proof.text: Use pullback pasting (IsPullback.paste_vert_iff) to identify the finite-level map as the base change of the local quotient Spec map. The quotient map is surjective, so apply IsClosedImmersion.spec_of_surjective and stability under base change (MorphismProperty.of_isPullback).

proof_origin.place: Tag 02OD, finite fibre factorisation, via the pullback square
